audience: craftsman businesses that manage customers, projects and invoices in HERO Software

useCases.title: List customers with their email and address
useCases.text: List the contacts with the category customer. Ask the assistant to show the number, name, email, phone and address of each one.

useCases.title: See which projects are open
useCases.text: List the projects with their trade, status and customer. Ask the assistant to show only the open ones and who the customer is.

useCases.title: Review a project with its documents and log
useCases.text: Open one project to read its customer documents and its log book entries. Use it to prepare a call with the customer.

useCases.title: Check the offers and invoices
useCases.text: List the customer documents with number, date, value, VAT and status. Ask the assistant to sum the invoices of one month.

useCases.title: Read other data with a custom query
useCases.text: Run a read-only GraphQL query, for example for calendar events or product versions. The server refuses mutations.
